shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

verses.gurmukhi: ਨੌਕਰ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਆਨ ਉਪਾਇ॥
verses.translit_en: nauakar hoi na sakiee karai su aan upai||

en.bdb: If one cannot render service, he should seek work elsewhere.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਹਤ ਨ ਨਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਈ ਟਹਿਲ ਕਮਾਇ॥੨੯॥
verses.translit_en: jeh bidh rahat na naas hoi soiee Tahil kamai||29||

en.bdb: One should practice a profession which does not involve any violation of the Rehat.

verses.gurmukhi: ਔਰ ਟਹਿਲ ਜੋ ਮਨ ਮੋ ਭਾਵੈ॥੩੦॥
verses.translit_en: aauar Tahil jo man mo bhaavai||30||

en.bdb: or any other profession which pleases your heart.
Earn through hard and honest work.
Fish and animal's flesh, never go after these.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਮੋ ਸਾਧ ਸਿੰਘ ਜੋ ਆਈ॥
verses.translit_en: ghar mo saadh si(n)gh jo aaiee||

en.bdb: Saintly Singhs who may come to your home;

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਈ॥੩੩॥
verses.translit_en: tin kee bahu bidh sev karaiee||33||

en.bdb: Wash their feat and offer food.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਾਵ ਸਭਨ ਮੋ ਲਿਆਵੈ॥੩੪॥
verses.translit_en: har ke bhaav sabhan mo liaavai||34||

en.bdb: Treat and serve every person with the love of God.
